text: The PBOC held its H2 2026 work meeting and said it will continue a moderately loose monetary stance. It will use reverse repos, the Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) and government bond operations to provide short-, medium- and long-term liquidity, keep liquidity ample and guide
text_zh: 中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议，表示将继续实施适度宽松的货币政策。将运用逆回购、中期借贷便利（MLF）和国债买卖等方式向市场投放短期、中期和长期流动性，保持流动性充裕并加以引导。
